---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - bioconda
  - conda-forge
dependencies:
  - bioconda::suppa=2.4
  - conda-forge::statsmodels=0.14.6

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process SUPPA_CLUSTEREVENTS {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/d8/d887a6a05dec2a1f64fdff0eac40581f9a1ec30301b2c267bde7f564b0f14270/data' :
        'community.wave.seqera.io/library/suppa:2.4--2612fcca3884f6bc' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(dpsi), path(psivec)
    val significance_threshold
    val dpsi_threshold
    val maximum_distance
    val metric
    val separation
    val min_number_events
    val groups
    val clustering_method

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.clustvec"), emit: clustvec
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('suppa'), eval("suppa.py -v | sed '1!d;s/.* //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_suppa
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('statsmodels'), eval("python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_statsmodels

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def sig_threshold_arg = significance_threshold ? "--sig-threshold ${significance_threshold}" : ''
    def dpsi_threshold_arg = dpsi_threshold ? "--dpsi-threshold ${dpsi_threshold}" : ''
    def eps_arg = maximum_distance ? "--eps ${maximum_distance}" : ''
    def metric_arg = metric ? ( ["euclidean", "manhattan", "cosine"].contains(metric) ? "--metric ${metric}" : error("Invalid metric: ${metric}. Must be one of: euclidean, manhattan, cosine") ) : ''
    def separation_arg = separation ? "--separation ${separation}" : ''
    def min_pts_arg = min_number_events ? "--min-pts ${min_number_events}" : ''
    def clustering_arg = clustering_method ? ( [ "DBSCAN", "OPTICS" ].contains(clustering_method) ? "--clustering ${clustering_method}" : error("Invalid clustering method: ${clustering_method}. Must be one of: DBSCAN, OPTICS") ) : ''

    clustering_method == 'optics' && !separation ? error("The 'optics' clustering method requires the '--separation' parameter to be set.") : ''

    """
    cp -L ${dpsi} local_${dpsi}
    cp -L ${psivec} local_${psivec}

    suppa.py \\
        clusterEvents \\
        --dpsi local_${dpsi} \\
        --psivec local_${psivec} \\
        ${sig_threshold_arg} \\
        ${dpsi_threshold_arg} \\
        ${eps_arg} \\
        ${metric_arg} \\
        ${separation_arg} \\
        ${min_pts_arg} \\
        --groups ${groups} \\
        ${clustering_arg} \\
        ${args} \\
        --output ${prefix}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo ${args}

    touch ./${prefix}.clustvec
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/suppa/clusterevents"
description: "Cluster events based on PSI values and significantly differentially\
  \ spliced events using SUPPA2."
keywords:
- "alternative splicing"
- "clustering"
- "suppa"
- "genomics"
tools:
- suppa:
    description: "Fast, accurate, and uncertainty-aware differential splicing analysis\
      \ across multiple conditions."
    homepage: "https://github.com/comprna/SUPPA"
    documentation: "https://github.com/comprna/SUPPA"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/comprna/SUPPA"
    doi: "10.1186/s13059-018-1417-1"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:suppa"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing differential splicing analysis information\n\
        e.g. `[ id:'diffsplice1' ]`\n"
  - dpsi:
      type: "file"
      description: "Differentially spliced events file"
      pattern: "*.{dpsi}"
      ontologies: []
  - psivec:
      type: "file"
      description: "PSI values for all events across all samples"
      pattern: "*.{psivec}"
      ontologies: []
- significance_threshold:
    type: "float"
    description: "P-value threshold to consider an event significant from the dpsi\
      \ file"
- dpsi_threshold:
    type: "float"
    description: "Lower-bound for the absolute delta PSI value to cluster"
    default: 0.05
- maximum_distance:
    type: "float"
    description: "Maximum distance (between 0 and 1) to consider two events as members\
      \ of the same cluster"
    default: 0.05
- metric:
    type: "string"
    description: "Distance metric. (allowed values are euclidean, manhattan, cosine)"
    default: "euclidean"
- separation:
    type: "float"
    description: "Maximum distance in PSI space of an event to a cluster (only for\
      \ OPTICS)"
- min_number_events:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Minimum number of events required per cluster"
    default: 20
- groups:
    type: "string"
    description: "Ranges of column numbers specifying the replicates per condition.\
      \ Column numbers have to be continuous, with no overlapping or missing columns\
      \ between them (e.g. 1-2,3-4)"
- clustering_method:
    type: "string"
    description: "Clustering method to use (allowed values are DBSCAN, OPTICS)"
    default: "DBSCAN"
output:
  clustvec:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing differential splicing analysis information\n\
          e.g. `[ id:'diffsplice1' ]`\n"
    - '*.clustvec':
        type: "file"
        description: "Clustered events file"
        pattern: "*.{clustvec}"
        ontologies: []
  versions_suppa:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - suppa:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - suppa.py -v | sed '1!d;s/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_statsmodels:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - statsmodels:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - suppa:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - suppa.py -v | sed '1!d;s/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - statsmodels:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@lathikaa"
- "@piplus2"
maintainers:
- "@piplus2"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
